_note: Bestiary quests (bible §7): a rare Patchling's page stays incomplete, and it can't be sealed, until its world task is done. Each step is done when its obstacle is cleared ('cleared', engine/fieldMoves.ts) or its story flag is set ('flag'). Shown as a page in the Journal's bestiary entry.

steps.text: Find the dim lantern on Route 1's storm-rod.
Get the clerk off the Cloud Clamp (Haydon's Taunt).
Reconnect the rod's cable (Nolan's Patch Up).
The storm is back. Wardeye waits at the rod in the rain.
